description: This Java class defines the PaymentIntent entity for a payment processing system, representing authorization attempts for orders with fields for IDs, amount, currency, status, and timestamps, along with persistence annotations and lifecycle callbacks.

classes.name: PaymentIntent
classes.description: Entity class representing a payment authorization attempt with fields for IDs, provider, currency, amount, status, timestamps, and related JPA annotations.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle callback invoked before persisting element to set creation and update timestamps.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: Lifecycle callback invoked before updating to refresh the update timestamp.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of this payment intent.

methods.name: getMerchantStoreId
methods.description: Returns the UUID of the merchant store associated with this payment.

methods.name: setMerchantStoreId
methods.description: Sets the UUID of the merchant store for this payment.

methods.name: getOrderId
methods.description: Returns the order UUID associated with this payment intent.

methods.name: setOrderId
methods.description: Sets the order UUID for this payment intent.

methods.name: getCustomerId
methods.description: Returns the UUID of the customer associated with this payment.

methods.name: setCustomerId
methods.description: Sets the customer UUID for this payment intent.

methods.name: getProvider
methods.description: Returns the payment provider used for this intent.

methods.name: setProvider
methods.description: Sets the payment provider for this intent.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Returns the currency code for this payment intent.

methods.name: setCurrency
methods.description: Sets the currency code.

methods.name: getAmountMinor
methods.description: Returns the amount in minor units.

methods.name: setAmountMinor
methods.description: Sets the amount in minor units.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the payment intent.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of the payment intent.

methods.name: getIdempotencyKey
methods.description: Returns the idempotency key for safe retries.

methods.name: setIdempotencyKey
methods.description: Sets the idempotency key.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Returns the creation timestamp.

methods.name: getUpdatedAt
methods.description: Returns the last update timestamp.
